messages:
emily: Heads-up — getting a surge of 5xx / p95 timeouts from a single tenant. p50 OK, p95 jumps ~8s, lots of 504s through the gateway. Suspect continuous-batcher priority inversion: longseq requests are holding up batches and short reqs pile behind them. traces: https://internal/traces/trace-83f7a

sameer: Which tenant + model? any repeated pattern?

emily: tenant=acme-pay, model=redwood-opt-6, longseq ~6000 tokens. Trace id trace-83f7a shows enqueue wait spikes and batch groups full of one long + many short reqs. batcher logs: `cbatcher.group_size=128`, `wait_for_fill=true` in code path.

maya: That's the lockstep effect — long requests prevent emission until batch is "full" so shorts wait. Do we have a repro?

support-joe: Customer has escalated (enterprise). They're seeing client retries + 504s. Need quick mitigation and a clear explanation.

emily: Quick repro I used locally: `./test/spike.sh --tenant acme --longseq 6000 --concurrency 20` — queue depth climbs and gateway p95 spikes. Minimal curl example:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"'"'x'"' * 6000}' https://api.redwood/v1/generate
```
Results: gateway logs show repeated `ERROR gateway: 504 request_id=abc123 queue_depth=412 wait_ms=8200`

sameer: Short-term mitigations: 1) set per-tenant `max_batch_wait_ms=40` on that pool to lower wait-for-fill exposure, OR 2) cap `max_batch_size=32` for tenant acme so longseqs don't dominate. Either will reduce batch lock time.

maya: We can also route large requests for acme to smaller/faster model during surge. Suggest: route requests >2k tokens to `opt-3-quant` for 30m. Ops, can you roll an override?

ops-bot: Started rollout r-998: apply tenant-routing override (acme -> opt-3-quant for payloads >2000 tokens) to pool-hosted-1. Target 5 instances.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-998 applied: 5/5 instances updated. Canary OK. Monitoring p95 and queue_depth.

sameer: Also adding an automated alert and auto-shedding policy: if `queue_depth > 400` on pool-hosted-1, shed non-enterprise low-tier traffic and send page. I'll open PR to add per-tenant queue caps.

emily: PR #412 opened (https://git.internal/pr/412) — adds per-tenant max-inflight + batch-size overrides. Long-term: implement priority-aware batching (preemptive slots) and batch composition telemetry. Filed INF-872 for design.

support-joe: Told customer we've applied temporary routing and are monitoring. Asked them to pause very long sequences where possible. Customer accepted temporary workaround; wants ETA for permanent fix.

maya: :thumbsup: Added repro notes + mitigation steps to incident runbook. Will keep thread open for 6h and mark for follow-up with infra/serving.
